name: Windows Audit Subcategory Settings Override Category Settings
description:
Ensures advanced audit policy subcategory settings override legacy category settings (SCENoApplyLegacyAuditPolicy = 1), otherwise the subcategory audit rules may not be applied.
Required Windows permission (remedy only): the LEA agent account must be allowed to run reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa" /v SCENoApplyLegacyAuditPolicy (administrator rights) via a delegated run-as permission, Scheduled Task, or service configuration.

_remedy.command: reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa" /v SCENoApplyLegacyAuditPolicy /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f | Out-Null; reg query "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa" /v SCENoApplyLegacyAuditPolicy
